versions.changelog:
Initial release: Optimize websites for both traditional and AI search engines (GEO) with a comprehensive SEO/GEO audit and planning system.

- Supports keyword strategy and clustering, site architecture, and multilingual URL structure.
- Delivers actionable on-page SEO for each page: titles, meta descriptions, headings, and intro sections.
- Recommends content enhancements for AI-citation readiness (clear answers, processes, FAQ, facts).
- Outlines topical authority strategy and robust internal linking plans.
- Specifies structured-data schema (FAQPage, HowTo, LocalBusiness, Service) for relevant pages.
- Ties every recommendation to traffic quality, rankings, AI-citation potential, or conversion.
